CREATE_DATABASE_QUERY: CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS pocketsmart
CREATE_USERS_TABLE_QUERY: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, full_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, phone_number VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL UNIQUE, email VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE, password VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;
DROP_COUNTRY_CODE_COLUMN_QUERY: ALTER TABLE users DROP COLUMN country_code
CREATE_ONBOARDING_TABLE_QUERY: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS user_onboarding (user_id INT PRIMARY KEY, allowance_amount VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, allowance_frequency VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, savings_goal_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, savings_target_amount VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, savings_time_to_reach INT NOT NULL, savings_goal_image VARCHAR(512) DEFAULT NULL, savings_progress_amount INT DEFAULT 0, current_balance VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT NULL, savings_progress_amount_2 INT DEFAULT 2200, savings_progress_amount_3 INT DEFAULT 3000, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;
ADD_SAVINGS_GOAL_IMAGE_COLUMN_QUERY: ALTER TABLE user_onboarding ADD COLUMN savings_goal_image VARCHAR(512) DEFAULT NULL
ADD_SAVINGS_PROGRESS_COLUMN_QUERY: ALTER TABLE user_onboarding ADD COLUMN savings_progress_amount INT DEFAULT 0
ADD_CURRENT_BALANCE_COLUMN_QUERY: ALTER TABLE user_onboarding ADD COLUMN current_balance VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT NULL
ADD_SAVINGS_PROGRESS_2_COLUMN_QUERY: ALTER TABLE user_onboarding ADD COLUMN savings_progress_amount_2 INT DEFAULT 2200
ADD_SAVINGS_PROGRESS_3_COLUMN_QUERY: ALTER TABLE user_onboarding ADD COLUMN savings_progress_amount_3 INT DEFAULT 3000
CREATE_GOALS_TABLE_QUERY: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS user_goals (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, user_id INT NOT NULL, name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, target_amount VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, time_to_reach INT NOT NULL, image_url VARCHAR(512) DEFAULT NULL, progress_amount INT DEFAULT 0, is_active TINYINT DEFAULT 1, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;
CREATE_TRANSACTIONS_TABLE_QUERY: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS user_transactions (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, user_id INT NOT NULL, title VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, category VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, amount DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL, date VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, icon VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, month_label VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, avoidable TINYINT DEFAULT 0, reason VARCHAR(255) DEFAULT '', created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;
